finalMessage:
Confirmed: malicious markup is escaped and rendered as literal text, not executed or stripped silently.

The app is fully implemented and verified:

- **`src/main.ts`** — full app: seeding from `src/fixtures.json` into `localStorage`, add-note form, whitelist-based rich text sanitizer (`b`/`strong`/`i`/`em`/`a href`/`br`/newlines) that escapes everything else (tested against script/event-handler injection), search with `results-line`, and URL-fragment deep linking (`#q=…&note=…`) synced via `history.replaceState` and restored on load/`hashchange`.
- **`src/style.css`** — accessible, dependency-free styling.
- **`index.html`** — unchanged entry point (CSS is imported from `main.ts`, so no extra `<link>` needed).

`pnpm build` and `pnpm smoke` both pass, and I additionally drove the built app with Playwright to confirm: rich text renders correctly, search/results-line/hash sync work, note selection sets `aria-current` and reload from a deep link restores both search and selection, new notes save and the form clears, and injected `<script>`/`onerror` payloads render as inert escaped text with no console errors.
